dct_title_s: Greece - Wildfire in Central Macedonia, Greece (EMSR918)
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR918. On 13 August 2026 at 12:00 CET, a wildfire started in the Chalkidiki Regional Unit of the Central Macedonia Region, Greece, near the village of Siviri. The residents of Siviri and Fourka were evacuated, while more than 170 firefighters and 15 aerial assets were involved in suppression operations, supported by municipal machinery and volunteer organisations. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide initial rough estimation, fire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping. **Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR918 **Product types present in this dataset's resources:** **DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary). Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
